Name: Guild Kill List
Author: Yadm
Description:
[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]
[line]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54022]Hired Help[/url]. Hire a neighbor, pay them, and they walk the farm and do the chores. Choose from 12 neighbors and more than 50 jobs: water, hoe, plant, harvest, the greenhouse, animals, kegs, jars, casks, furnaces, forage, trees, and hay.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url]. Inventory and chest buttons from other mods share one column.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url]. After Qi's Walnut Room unlocks, an inventory button opens the game's perfection tracker.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53144]Staircase Spacing[/url]. A staircase stays in your bag when another ladder is already nearby in the Mines or Skull Cavern.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54345]Sprinklers All Day[/url]. A sprinkler fires every two hours when a dry tilled tile is in reach. The 6:00 AM watering stays the game's.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Video[/heading]
[line]
[youtube]VHBYF-AW58g[/youtube]
[line]


[b][size=4]The list, from your inventory[/size][/b]

After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon sends a letter and asks you to visit the Adventurer's Guild. On that visit he walks over to meet you, then tells you the monster eradication list is in your pack. From then on, a button on the inventory screen opens the goals. The tooltip is "Monster Eradication Goals". It does not cover the item grid, and it is not an item. A tooltip from an item in the bag draws over the sword.

The board on the guild wall still opens the old letter. The sword opens a list where you can pin goals. Click a row to pin one, and click it again to unpin it. You can pin more than one. Each row shows the monster. A goal you have not counted a kill for stays blocked, the same as the letter: question marks, no picture, and it cannot be pinned. After the first counted kill, the next time you open the list it shows the name and the picture.

While a goal is pinned, each kill that counts toward it shows a banner like an item you just picked up, with the monster, the goal name, and the count. If one kill counts for more than one pinned goal, each goal gets its own banner. Only your own kills are announced. A kill the guild board does not count does not show a banner. When a pinned goal is finished, that kill still shows the banner, then the pin comes off. Pin it again to keep watching later kills.

[heading]How you get it[/heading]
[list]
[*]You can already enter the Adventurer's Guild, the way you normally would.[/*]
[*]You have reached floor 100 of the Mines. The Skull Cavern does not count. A save that already reached the floor still qualifies, including while the Mines are dangerous.[/*]
[*]Marlon's letter is in the mailbox the same day. Read it.[/*]
[*]Go to the guild. If another scene is already playing, his visit waits for another trip.[/*]
[*]You and Marlon walk toward each other. He tells you to open your inventory and check the list from anywhere.[/*]
[*]The button is there after that conversation. Skipping the scene still counts.[/*]
[/list][heading]Install Easy Access Buttons with this mod[/heading]

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url] with this mod. The sword joins its column and lines up with the Community Center button, Organize, and the other mods that want the same inventory spot. Reorder or hide it from the gear menu there. That shared column is what this mod is made for.

[size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url][/b][/size]
by Yadm

One column for the inventory buttons that would otherwise cover each other. Guild Kill List joins that column on its own. Without Easy Access Buttons, the sword stays in its old spot under Organize, where other mods can cover it.

[heading]Options[/heading]

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, these are the settings. Without that menu, the button still appears once Marlon has given it to you, the sword opens the pin list, and a finished goal drops its pin.
[list]
[*][b]Show the guild list in inventory[/b] starts on.[/*]
[*][b]Classic list from inventory[/b] starts off. Turn it on and the sword opens the old guild letter. The wall always opens that letter.[/*]
[*][b]Unpin a finished goal[/b] starts on.[/*]
[*][b]Pinned goals[/b] is a page of the same pins, saved on this farmer. Goals you have not killed yet show as ??? and cannot be checked. On the title screen the pins cannot be changed.[/*]
[/list][heading]Languages[/heading]

The letter, the guild visit, the inventory list, and the options are in English, Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, German, and French.

The list title uses the game's own name for the monster eradication board. Goal names and the kill banner come from the game. A line with no translation stays in English.

Choose the language on the title screen before you load the save.
[heading]Install[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later, and SMAPI 4.1.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Install SMAPI, then install this mod with Vortex, or unzip the folder into your Mods folder. You should have Mods/GuildKillList/manifest.json.[/*]
[*]Install Easy Access Buttons the same way. Guild Kill List still loads on its own, and the sword then keeps its old spot.[/*]
[*]Works alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Marlon in that guild is used for the visit.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: After the mine floor in the options, Marlon writes and adds the eradication list to your inventory. 100 is the usual floor. You can set 50 to 120. Install Easy Access Buttons so the sword lines up. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.14+ and SMAPI 4.1.0+.
